note: Codex (as of 2026-05) does not expose SessionStart / UserPromptSubmit / PostToolUse hook equivalents to Claude Code. mwe-mcp cannot ship a Codex hook bundle until that surface exists. Use the mwe-mcp skills directly from chat (or from your consumer's system prompt) as the entry point: load `core-globalmemory` for transversal recall when the cwd has no `.mwe/state.json`, or `smart-consumer` for smart-wiki-bound work.
fallback_pattern: Without hooks, the consumer must invoke the relevant mwe-mcp skill explicitly at session start. The skill catalogue (`GET /skills`) and `skill_fetch` MCP tool let you pull skill bodies on demand; system-prompt augmentation is the universal fallback for consumers without a native skill loader. The three options are: a native skill loader, system-prompt augmentation, or `InitializeResult.instructions`.
